test_title: PYST 29: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

A stranger buys flowers for the dead man’s grave.

options.text: Flowers is bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.
Flowers were bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.
Flowers have been bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.
Flowers are bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **Flowers are bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **active voice. **We need to change it into **passive voice.**
 
• The subject of the given sentence is **'A stranger'** and the object is **'flowers'.**
 
• The positions of the subject and the object will be interchanged.
 
• The given sentence is in** simple present tense.**
 
• **'Buys'** changes to** 'are brought'.**
 
• **Simple present tense** changes in the following manner:-
 
 
• The format of Active voice is: **Subject + V1/ V5 + Object**.
 
• Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: **Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + am/is/are + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).**
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

**Correct Passive Voice**__: *Flowers are bought by a stranger for the dead man’s grave.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When we convert **active voice to passive voice**, three things need to be kept in mind:-

 
 
• Change object into subject.
 
• Change subject into object.
 
• Always use the **third form of the verb** in the passive voice.
 
• Use **'by' **before the new object.
